statement: Intel Foundry signed Fortinet as a named external customer for the Fortinet Security Processor 6, with Intel providing design, packaging and manufacturing; no dollar value or volume was disclosed.
why: A named outside foundry customer is evidence that alternative leading-edge manufacturing capacity outside TSMC is becoming commercially usable, which over time widens the supply base for custom silicon.

impact.mechanism: Winning a purpose-built ASIC program gives Intel Foundry a reference customer, supporting diversification of wafer and advanced-packaging supply away from a single dominant foundry.

evidence.excerpt: Intel and Fortinet Collaborate to Advance Cybersecurity Innovation and Strengthen Global Supply Chain Resilience
No dollar value, unit volume, or revenue figure is given in the Intel release.

confidence.basis: Company newsroom item recorded here as a secondary-tier document with no financial disclosure; trade-press corroboration was noted but not separately fetched, so capped at medium.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend flat -> rising); sources: Intel Newsroom press release (newsroom.intel.com), ServeTheHome
